label: Bible Study
prompt: And that every _____ should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verse: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
note: The climax of Philippians 2 — every tongue confessing, echoing Isaiah 45:23.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good _____ unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verse: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
note: If imperfect parents know how to give good gifts, Jesus says, imagine what the perfect Father has in mind.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the number of them that _____, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
verse: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
note: God's strange recruiting test: the three hundred who lapped water from their hands made Gideon's army.

label: Deep Water
prompt: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how _____ I am.
verse: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
note: David asks God to show him how short life is — and in the next verse calls it a handbreadth.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be _____:
verse: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
note: Peter's checklist for church life ends small and practical: 'be pitiful, be courteous.'
